questions.stem: A 6-month-old infant, Krish, is presented to the pediatric clinic with symptoms of a high-pitched cough, runny nose, and a mild fever. Upon inquiry, the mother reveals that Krish received his pertussis vaccine two days ago. The physician considers the possibility of a vaccine-related adverse event. Which of the following is the most common side effect of the pertussis vaccine, and how should it be managed in this case?
questions.stemHtml: A 6-month-old infant, Krish, is presented to the pediatric clinic with symptoms of a high-pitched cough, runny nose, and a mild fever. Upon inquiry, the mother reveals that Krish received his pertussis vaccine two days ago. The physician considers the possibility of a vaccine-related adverse event. Which of the following is the most common side effect of the pertussis vaccine, and how should it be managed in this case?

options.label: A
options.text: Severe allergic reaction- recommend immediate administration of epinephrine

options.label: B
options.text: Febrile seizure- recommend antipyretic therapy and observation

options.label: C
options.text: Localized pain and swelling at the injection site- recommend cold compresses and pain relief medication

options.label: D
options.text: Anaphylaxis- recommend referral to the emergency department for further management
